verses.text: If only you’d tear open the heavens and come down! The mountains would shake in front of you,
like fire lighting up dry brush or making water boil. Make your name known to your enemies so the nations shake when you show up!
You did awesome things we never saw coming. You came down, and the mountains shook in front of you.
From way back, nobody’s ever heard of or seen another God like you, a God who acts for those who wait for him.
You meet people who take joy in doing what’s right, who remember you by following your ways. Look, you were angry, and we sinned. We’ve been at it a long time. Can we still be saved?
We’ve all become unclean, and all the right things we’ve done are like filthy clothes. We all wither like leaves, and our own wrongs blow us away like the wind.
Nobody calls on your name or gets up to grab hold of you. You’ve hidden your face from us and let our wrongdoing consume us.
But now, LORD, you’re our Father. We’re the clay, and you’re the potter. Every one of us is a piece of work from your hand.
Don’t be furious, LORD. Don’t hold our wrongs in your memory forever. Please, take a look. We’re all your people.
Your holy cities have turned into wilderness. Zion is a wilderness. Jerusalem is a ruin.
Our holy and beautiful house, where our ancestors praised you, went up in flames. Everything we loved has been laid waste.
After all this, LORD, will you still hold back? Will you stay silent and punish us so severely?
